plans: Skip cache insertion when the resolved subproblem response carries a cycle marker, then compare cache-enabled and cache-disabled results on a cyclic traversal and verify that ordinary acyclic subproblems still hit.
Check the visited-path set before cache lookup, returning a cycle denial before any cached entry can be replayed, and verify the acyclic hit rate is unchanged.
Make the cache key depend on the canonical visited-path set or a cycle-context fingerprint, accepting higher key cardinality to eliminate all path-dependent reuse.
Bypass both lookup and insertion for any request with non-empty visited state, a conservative correctness-first repair that reduces subproblem cache coverage.
